name: Amazon Image Production - Submit Generate QA Send Approval

parameters.formDescription: Submit SKU product data and reference image URLs.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "sku": $json.sku,
  "slot": $json.slot,
  "version": $json.version,
  "prompt": $json.image_prompt,
  "reference_images": $json.reference_images,
  "size": "2000x2000",
  "format": "png",
  "negative_prompt": "competitor logos, website, email, phone number, QR code, social handle, extra products, incorrect product quantity, misspelled text"
}

parameters.jsCode:
const meta = $('Extract Generated Image URL').item.json;
return [{ json: { ...meta, drive_file_id: $json.id, drive_file_url: $json.webViewLink || $json.webUrl || meta.generated_image_url } }];
